prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: I thought they canceled all the swim lessons. Why are you packing a towel?
spokenPromptZh: 我以為他們把所有游泳課都取消了。你怎麼還在準備毛巾？

options.text: Only the outdoor class was canceled.
options.whyZh: 修正對方誤以為全部取消的前提，因此可以解釋為何仍準備毛巾。

options.text: The blue towel is still damp.
options.whyZh: 說毛巾狀態，不解釋還要去上課。

options.text: The changing room has two benches.
options.whyZh: 更衣室設備跟取消哪一班無關。

explanationZh: 修正對方誤以為全部取消的前提，因此可以解釋為何仍準備毛巾。
evidence: I thought they canceled all the swim lessons. Why are you packing a towel? / Only the outdoor class was canceled.

vocabulary.note: damp 表示微濕；still 表示狀態持續到說話當下。
